correctness.rationale: Let xy=x1*y1 e2+(x1*y4+x4*y1)e4 over char(K)≠2. Then J(e1,e1,e4)=2e4, and the printed alpha(e1)=-e1-e3 has square e2 while alpha(e2)=a12 e1+e2+2e4, giving a fixed nonzero multiplicativity defect. For a general endomorphism write alpha(e1)=lambda e1+u e2+v e3+w e4. From alpha(e2)=alpha(e1)^2=lambda²e2+2lambda w e4 and e1e2=0, obtain 2lambda²w=0. If lambda=0, alpha(e2)=alpha(e4)=0, alpha(e1),alpha(e3) lie in span(e2,e3,e4) (six parameters). If lambda≠0, w=0, alpha(e2)=lambda²e2, alpha(e3) lies in span(e2,e3), and alpha(e4)=t e4 with (1-lambda)t=0. All remaining relations hold, proving exhaustiveness. Multiplicativity yields J_alpha=alpha² J, and the image of J is K e4, hence validity iff alpha²(e4)=0: automatically in Type I and iff t=0 in Type II. Invertibility requires lambda=1, s,t≠0 so no invertible valid twist. Counting gives q^6+(q-1)q^4 valid and q^4(q²+2q-2) total, q^4(q-1) invalid, q^3(q-1)^2 automorphisms, and extension-field counts imply the reduced-locus zeta ratio (1-q^4T)/((1-q^6T)(1-q^5T)). Independent finite F3 enumeration based on image constraints found 729 valid Type I, 162 valid Type II and 162 invalid Type II maps, total 1053, and verified all basis identities; it is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2021 primary paper and its 2025 indexed journal passage contain the defective Example 3.4(ii) but no reported exhaustive salvage. Burde–Fialowski already structurally exclude the printed algebra from true four-dimensional JJ algebras, so neither the easy Jacobi countercheck nor the general Yau twisting principle is credited as new. The surviving exact result is the full algebra-endomorphism parametrization, the necessary/sufficient Hom-JJ condition, no-automorphism fact and uniform finite-field/zeta counts for this concrete non-JJ multiplication. Four Resultary and multiple exact web searches found no direct earlier coverage; inaccessible/unindexed corrections remain an explicit priority risk.
residual_risks: The 2025 journal PDF itself was not materially inspected; its indexed complete Example 3.4(ii) is identical, but a separate erratum or unindexed correction may exist.
Publisher access to the 2024 Axioms full article was rate-limited; only the indexed relevant classification was assessed. No whole-article noncoverage is claimed.

An unindexed algebra-endomorphism classification or equivalent twist-locus computation under a different name could predate the submitted classification; Resultary and web searches are not exhaustive.

value.rationale: The incorrectly specified algebra and self-morphism appear in a named four-dimensional illustrative construction of a research article and its later indexed journal version. A reader trying to reuse the example needs to know exactly which genuine endomorphisms yield valid Hom-Jacobi–Jordan structures; the complete two-branch answer, exclusion of invertible twists and finite-field scheme counts provide this mathematically motivated replacement rather than only a cheap single counterexample. The positive twists collapse the e1e4 multiplication (Type I gives the zero twisted product; Type II gives only e1⋆e1=lambda²e2), so no nontrivial retention of the original e1e4 interaction is claimed. No general classification of all four-dimensional Hom-JJ structures is asserted.
risks: Extremely low-dimensional base and elementary parameter computations; value depends on the concrete published error and exhaustive correction, not a broad structure theorem.
